summary: launch the ops terminal UI (ops-ui) — the ops.json/3 contract-driven frontend
usage: ops ui [args passed through to ops-ui]
hints: Entry shim for the terminal UI: execs the installed `ops-ui` binary (found on PATH, or via OPS_UI_BIN), handing it the terminal — the TUI itself composes verbs over `ops <verb> --json` + `ops complete`. When ops-ui isn't installed it prints a blocked-style install hint and exits cleanly (never a crash). Common mistake: expecting `ops ui --json` to stream data — it launches an interactive UI (tty:true); drive ops programmatically with `ops <verb> --json` instead.
